evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Both bundles intact. Small internal ganglion cyst likely sequela of prior sprain.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Inner margin blunting of the lateral meniscus body.
evidence.Medial OA: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the posterior weightbearing medial femoral condyle.
evidence.Lateral OA: Low-grade cartilage loss along the posterior high nonweightbearing lateral femoral condyle.
evidence.PF OA: Full-thickness cartilage loss overlying the medial patellar facet and median ridge.
evidence.Contusion: Full-thickness fissuring at the high posterior nonweightbearing medial femoral condyle with subchondral marrow edema.
evidence.Fracture: Healing non-displaced fracture along the medial patella.
